shell_commands: cat .lore/test-commands.yml && ls scripts/spec-links/ 2>/dev/null; ls specs/ | head -30

sed -n '100,175p' eslint.config.mjs; echo ===; grep -rn "no-nondeterministic" node_modules/eslint-plugin-re-lint/dist/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -5; ls node_modules/eslint-plugin-re-lint/dist/ 2>/dev/null | head
grep -n "re-lint\|reLint" eslint.config.mjs | head -5; grep -rn "require-spec-link" --include="*.mjs" --include="*.js" -l . 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head
ls scripts/ && ls scripts/spec-links 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; grep -rn "@spec\|spec:" scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs | head -20
grep -rn "VALIDATED_BY\|spec" scripts/lib/*.mjs 2>/dev/null | grep -i "validated\|spec field\|descriptor" | head -10; ls scripts/lib/
which lore-query-trace lore 2>/dev/null; ls /usr/local/bin 2>/dev/null | grep -i lore; npx lore-query-trace --help 2>&1 | head -5
grep -n "^  it(" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts | sed -n '1,12p'; echo ----; grep -n "^  it(" src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts
grep -n "    it('wraps an undefined rejection" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts; grep -n "    it('wraps a non-Error rejection" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts
node scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs 2>&1 | tail -3; echo "exit=$?"; node scripts/check-spec-links.mjs specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md 2>&1 | tail -3; git diff --stat

git diff specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md | grep -E "^[+-]" | grep -vE "^[+-]{3}" | grep -oE "#L[0-9]+" | sort | uniq -c | head; echo ----; git diff specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md | grep -E "^\+" | grep -cvE "^\+\+"
git diff specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md | grep -E "^\+" | grep -vE "^\+\+\+" | head -4
node --experimental-vm-modules node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts 2>&1 | tail -5; node scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs 2>&1 | tail -2
git log -1 --format=%B a887884; echo ----; git log -1 --format=%B 64143f7

git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-architecture/spec.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts src/orchestration/onErrorNonError.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
test(orchestrator): pin undefined onError case

A rejection with `undefined` now has the wrapping pinned at both
levels: the acceptance file gains the case next to string and plain
object, and the unit suite pins it beside the existing non-Error wrap
test. The acceptance file's clock read is replaced with a fixed
timestamp so the suite is repeatable (eslint). Spec anchors shifted by
the inserted test are repointed and the config-hooks statement names
`undefined` explicitly.

Refs: re-cinq/HALEngine#95

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
git fetch origin main 2>&1 | tail -2 && git merge origin/main --no-edit 2>&1 | tail -5
